module: Variable storage of a flowgraph project (project global variables read/written by the getVariable/setVariable nodes). The module returns a constructor: `require('flowgraph_variableStorage')(mgr)`. Each variable has a name, a type (string, number, bool, vec3, quat, color), a base value, a current value, a merge strategy (see `flowgraph_utils`) and options (fixed type, undeletable, monitored, kept after stop). The frame's writes go through `change` then are merged by `finalizeChanges`.
usage:
local vs = mgr.variables
vs:addVariable('score', 0, 'number', 'sum')
vs:change('score', 10)
vs:finalizeChanges()
local v, ok = vs:get('score')
notes: Three ways to write: `changeBase` (start value + current, with type check), `changeInstant` (current value only, no merge) and `change` (goes through the merge strategy, effective after `finalizeChanges`).
On stop (`_executionStopped`), each variable goes back to its `baseValue`, except those marked `keepAfterStop`, whose current value becomes the new base.
Default strategies if the requested one is invalid: `last`, `max` for a number, `or_` for a bool.
`updateType` resets the value to a default of the type (false, 0, '', {0,0,0}...) and does not work if `fixedType`.
Probable bug: `renameVariable` does not update the `name` field of the renamed variable and calls `table.insert(customVariableOrder, nil, newName)` if the old name was not in the custom order.

Probable bug: `_onDeserialized` does `self.customVariableOrder = self.customVariableOrder or data.customVariableOrder`; since `customVariableOrder` always exists (a table), the saved order is ignored (the order is rebuilt by `addVariable`).
`changeCustomVariableOrder` crashes if the name is not in `customVariableOrder` (`oldIdx` nil).

C.desc: Variable storage instance. Fields: mgr, id, variables (name -> {name, baseValue, value, index, type, fixedType, undeletable, mergeStrat, mergeFuns, monitored, keepAfterStop}), variableChanges, sortedVariableNames, customVariableOrder, types.

init.desc: Constructor: takes a unique id from the manager, creates the tables and completes the type list with the editor's color and icon.

getName.desc: Returns "(manager name / manager id)" for logs.

getTypes.desc: List of supported variable types (string, number, bool, vec3, quat, color) with color and icon.

getMergeStrats.desc: Returns the sorted merge strategies offered for a type (see `sortedMergeFuns`).

returns.desc: List {name, desc, num}, empty if unknown.

get.desc: Reads a variable's current value. Logs an error if it does not exist.

getFull.desc: Returns the variable's full table (value, type, strategy...).

clear.desc: Deletes all variables and pending changes.

changeCustomVariableOrder.desc: Moves a variable in `customVariableOrder` so that it is placed before/after index `newIdx` (relative to the original order).

getMaxSortIndex.desc: Largest sort `index` among the variables (0 if none).

addVariable.desc: Adds a variable. Returns false (and logs an error) if it already exists.

setMergeStrat.desc: Sets the merge strategy and initializes it. An invalid strategy is replaced by a default value depending on the type.

returns.desc: false if the variable does not exist.

updateType.desc: Changes a variable's type (values reset to a default of the type), switches back to the `last` strategy and notifies the getVariable/setVariable nodes.

returns.desc: false if nonexistent or fixed type.

setMonitor.desc: Marks the variable as monitored (displayed in the editor).

setKeepAfterStop.desc: If true, the current value becomes the base value when the project stops (kept).

removeVariable.desc: Deletes a variable (unless `undeletable`) and removes it from the custom order.

renameVariable.desc: Renames a variable and notifies the getVariable/setVariable nodes of all graphs and macros.

changeBase.desc: Changes the base value and the current value, after a type compatibility check.

returns.desc: false if nonexistent or incompatible type.

changeInstant.desc: Immediately changes the current value, with no merge and no type check.

change.desc: Submits a value to the variable's merge strategy; effective after `finalizeChanges`. Rejects nil.

returns.desc: false if nonexistent or nil value.

finalizeChanges.desc: Finalizes the merges of all modified variables (`finalize`, then `init`) and empties the change list. Called by the manager at the end of the frame (inferred from code).

_onClear.desc: Called when the project is cleared; equivalent to `_executionStopped`.

_executionStopped.desc: Called on stop: empties the pending changes and resets each variable to its base value (or keeps its value if `keepAfterStop`).

_onSerialize.desc: Serializes the variables: {list = [{name, value=baseValue, index, type, mergeStrat, fixedType, undeletable, monitored, keep}], customVariableOrder}.

_onDeserialized.desc: Reloads the variables from the save data (accepts the old format without `list`), sorted by index then name.
